note: The two sets contain the same three claims with the same values and quotes; the only difference is how the 'S-301' reference next to the through-bolt callout is handled. Set A keeps it inside the quote, which is harmless, while Set B promotes it to a 'condition', misbinding a sheet/detail reference as an engineering condition. Otherwise both bind the 3/8" bolt diameter and the L3X3X1/4 angle designation correctly, and both carry the same questionable 'C1 thickness 3/16"' claim.
remarks: Both sets assert 'C1 | thickness | 3/16"' but 3/16" does not appear in the text layer and C1 is a detail callout (MODULE B - PV STRUCTURAL MEMBER - NORTH/SOUTH), not a component with a stated thickness; this claim looks misbound or unsupported in both. The L3X3X1/4 claim states the designation as a 'dimension' with unit '"', which is redundant/odd since the value already encodes the units. Many dimension strings in the text layer (e.g. 10'-3 3/4", 12'-3 3/4", 2'-2 7/8") and the 3/8" THROUGH BOLT quantity/location are not claimed by either sample, but since the samples are declared complete for both, this is neutral.
